ratios.facility: Credit Facility (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement)
Credit Facility (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement)

parsed.notes: The leverage ratio is expressed as a percentage (actual 15.1%, maximum 60%), not as a multiple; the Credit Facility defines it, and it is likely a debt-to-capitalization-type measure. Minimum tangible net worth is in thousands of dollars: the requirement is $3,767,215K, which is the $3.3 billion base after escalation. The covenant table also shows investments other than permitted investments of $57,268K against a limit of $1,568,709K; this is a dollar limit rather than a ratio, so it is not included. The debt-to-capital (26.0%) and net debt-to-capital (16.9%) figures are non-GAAP measures not tied to a covenant, so they are excluded. The leverage-based pricing grid is also excluded.
